mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.template_id as templateId, c.status, c.obtain_time as obtainTime, c.expire_time as expireTime, c.use_order_id as useOrderId, c.use_time as useTime, t.name as templateName, t.type as templateType, t.threshold, t.discount, t.scope_type as scopeType, t.apply_category_id as applyCategoryId, t.apply_product_ids as applyProductIds
mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (user_id, template_id, status, obtain_time, expire_time, use_order_id, use_time) select #{userId}, t.id, 0, #{eligibilityTime}, case when t.valid_type = 1 then t.end_time when t.valid_type = 2 then date_add(#{eligibilityTime}, interval t.valid_days day) end, null, null from coupon_template t where t.id = #{templateId} and t.status = 1 and ( (t.valid_type = 1 and t.start_time < t.end_time and t.start_time <= #{eligibilityTime} and #{eligibilityTime} < t.end_time) or (t.valid_type = 2 and t.valid_days > 0) )
mapper.select: select c.id, c.user_id as userId, c.template_id as templateId, c.status, c.obtain_time as obtainTime, c.expire_time as expireTime, c.use_order_id as useOrderId, c.use_time as useTime from user_coupon c where c.id = #{id} for update
select count(*) from user_coupon where user_id = #{userId} and template_id = #{templateId}
select count(*) from user_coupon where template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.update: update user_coupon set use_order_id = #{orderId} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 3 and use_order_id is null
update user_coupon set status = 1, use_time = now() where use_order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 3
update user_coupon set status = 0, use_order_id = null where use_order_id = #{orderId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 3
update user_coupon set status = 2 where status = 0 and expire_time <= now(3)
mapper.select: select from user_coupon c inner join coupon_template t on c.template_id = t.id where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 0 and c.expire_time > now(3) and t.status = 1 and ((t.valid_type = 2 and t.valid_days > 0) or (t.valid_type = 1 and t.start_time < t.end_time and t.start_time <= now(3) and now(3) < t.end_time)) order by c.expire_time asc
